title: AI VTuber Speech Lifecycle Event
description: Provider-neutral speech lifecycle record (issue #222 S2, ADR-0004 D5): what the scheduler/audio execution path knows about one spoken unit (a reply, or one phrase of a phrased reply). Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::SpeechLifecycleEvent. Audit and replay data only: it carries no authority, source class, trust or capability, and no free text (digests and identities only). The scheduler owns the truth: a TTS provider reporting synthesis done is `prepared`, never `finished`. `basis` says how a fact was observed; a consumer must not treat `logical_timeline` as audible (ADR-0004 D-6). Times are integer milliseconds on the scheduler's logical timeline, never wall-clock; ordering is by `seq`.

schema_version.description: Contract version. An incompatible version is refused rather than reinterpreted.

seq.description: Per-process monotonic sequence assigned by the log. A gap tells a slow consumer that events were dropped.

at_ms.description: Scheduler logical time of the fact. Not wall-clock; not globally monotonic across units.

basis.description: How the fact was observed. Only finished and cancelled may carry an output-observed basis.

allOf.description: A unit that has not been committed has no scheduler generation yet.
Committed, started, boundary and finished events always carry the generation.
A cancellation before commit has no generation; one after commit has it.
Only finished and cancelled may carry an output-observed basis.

label.description: An identity or audit label: no control characters.

event_id.description: The scheduler item's event id (phrases after the first derive {root}#p{seq}); clipped by the producer. generation and seq identify the unit exactly.

generation.description: The scheduler attempt id. Present exactly once the unit has been committed. Not the generative pipeline's generation attempt (ADR-0004 D-7).

phrase.description: Zero-based phrase position; a reply that is not phrased is phrase 0.

final_phrase.description: Whether this is the last phrase of the planned reply.

speech_text_digest.description: SHA-256 of the text sent to TTS (speech_text when it differs from the display text, else the display text). Never the text itself (retention rule in docs/domain-contract.adoc).

projection.description: The projection identity recorded in the asset (compatibility.speech_projection), when it carries one.

offset_ms.description: Declared safe-interrupt point, in milliseconds from the unit's start.

reached.description: How far the unit had got; computed by the log, never supplied by a reporter.

spoken_ms.description: Present exactly when reached is started: logical milliseconds between the start and the cancellation.
